gaps.description: Validated AMQP user_id establishes producer identity. Bridge signs ingress with a bridge/validator key; validator signs approval with a separate validator/writer key. Caller policy and signatures are checked; trusted-service assumptions and protected network remain explicit.
Secured commands require aware deadlines. Writer checks on receipt and at native write boundaries after connection setup. Cross-host clock uncertainty and runtime E0 cases remain pending.

SQLite ledger on writer PVC binds admitted command IDs to immutable digests, serializes claims and retains lifecycle results. Pre-write recovery may retry while live; started recovery remains unknown. Default retention 24 hours after deadline or latest lifecycle transition. Single writer, surviving volume and correct clocks are assumptions.

Writer returns completed/not_executed/pending/unknown/conflict; orchestrator reports missing writer replies as unknown and preserves retained completion timestamps. Full stage traces and physical outcome reconciliation remain pending.
Inspection is a versioned JSON string inside unversioned SOSA; event classification and receiver binding are study mappings, not enforced end to end.
Polling latest inspection registers can miss events; restart clears in-memory deduplication.
Metrics and logs do not form a complete attributable timed execution trace.
One local cluster is the documented baseline; cloud admission and edge writing are not yet separated.
The declared graph is not a security boundary or proof that unlisted runtime connections cannot occur.

source_baseline_note: Topology baseline pinned above; command security added subsequently in the working tree. Conformance remains not assessed.

security.approach: HMAC-SHA256 with independent ingress and approval keys
security.producer_identity: RabbitMQ AMQP 0-9-1 validated user_id; no impersonator tags
security.trust: Broker, bridge, validator, writer, Kubernetes administrators and secret provisioning are trusted. Either holder of a given HMAC key can generate that evidence.
limits: Writer ledger prevents repeated execution of the same admitted command ID within its retention policy. Producer-generated new IDs and lost/deleted ledger storage are outside that guarantee.
No TLS provided by this change; current setup assumes protected local network and clocks.
MQTT measurement authenticity and authenticated command outcome reports are not established by approval signing.

execution_policy.scope: Admitted commands reaching the single writer; separate event/business-effect deduplication remains scoped independently.
execution_policy.storage: SQLite WAL with synchronous FULL on actuation-command-ledger PVC
execution_policy.restart: preparing -> retryable, started -> unknown; completed results retained
execution_policy.expired_retries: Authenticated expired requests may retrieve retained results only; an expired command never starts or restarts a write.
execution_policy.cli: scripts/control.py --save-command PATH; --retry-command PATH preserves entire original command
not_claimed: High availability across independent writer replicas or ledger copies
Duplicate protection after losing the ledger volume
Automatic reconciliation of ambiguous physical outcomes
